texts.close_hint: Iminsi 30 yo guhindura igitekerezo. LynkID yawe ntizigera ihabwa undi.
texts.close_requested: Ifungwa ku ya {when}. Injira mbere y'icyo gihe kugira ngo uyigumane.
texts.contact_hint: Twohereje kode y'imibare 6. Irangira mu minota 10.
texts.download_hint: Biteguye mu minsi 30, hanyuma biboneka iminsi 7.
texts.exchange_link: Ibikorwa byo kuvunja biri muri LynkOmni Exchange.
texts.keep_one_passkey: Gumana nibura urufunguzo rumwe rwo kwinjira. Ongeraho urundi mbere yo gukuraho uru.
texts.last_owner_note: Nyiri ubucuruzi wa nyuma ntashobora gusohoka. Banza wimure ubwiru.
texts.memberships_body: Ubunyamuryango bwa LynkBooking na LynkEssential bugaragara hano iyo winjiyemo.
texts.never_allowed: Ntibikorwa na rimwe: SMS yonyine, ibibazo by'umutekano, gusubizaho kuri telefoni, imeyili yonyine.
texts.no_connected_apps: Nta kintu gisangirwa n'umuntu uwo ari we wese.
texts.no_plans: Gahunda zose ziri ku Buntu. Nta cyo kwishyura.
texts.notice_consent: Gusangira n'umucungamari wawe birangira mu minsi 7
texts.notice_renewal: LynkPOS Plus yongera kwiyandikisha mu minsi 7
texts.overview_security_ok: Umutekano: infunguzo {n} zo kwinjira, kode yo kugarura yashyizweho
texts.passkey_added: Urufunguzo rwo kwinjira rwongewe kuri iki gikoresho
texts.passkey_hint: Urufunguzo rwo kwinjira rusimbura ijambo ry'ibanga. Ongeraho rumwe kuri iki gikoresho ubu; ongeraho igikoresho cya kabiri vuba.
texts.path_assisted_body: Icyangombwa kikuranga, igihamya cy'ubucuruzi n'igenzura rikorwa ako kanya. Hanyuma utegereze amasaha 72 n'uruhushya rw'abakozi babiri. Ntibikorwa kuri telefoni na rimwe.
texts.path_code: Kode yo kugarura na kode ya SMS
texts.path_code_body: Shyiramo kode zombi. Hanyuma utegereze amasaha 24: buri gikoresho cyanditswe n'umuntu wawe w'inyongera baramenyeshwa, kandi uwo ari we wese ashobora guhagarika.
texts.path_device_body: Fungura LynkOmni ku kindi gikoresho wemeze ukoresheje PIN yacyo. Ugaruka ako kanya.
texts.payment_methods: Uburyo bwo kwishyura (binyuze ku watanze serivisi)
texts.payslips_empty: Nta mpapuro z'umushahara ziraboneka. Zigaragara hano iyo umukoresha akwishyuye binyuze muri LynkOmni.
texts.recover_question_device: Ufite indi telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa winjiyemo?
texts.recovery_cancel_note: Igikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose cyanditswe cyangwa umuntu wawe w'inyongera ashobora kubihagarika.
texts.recovery_code_hint: Yerekanwa rimwe gusa. Yandike ku rupapuro uyibike kure ya telefoni yawe. Ntizigera yoherezwa nanone.
texts.recovery_code_push: Ibikurikira: andikisha igikoresho cya kabiri cyangwa umufatanyanyiri uyu munsi. Ni bwo buryo bwihuse bwo kugaruka.
texts.recovery_restricted: Nyuma yo kugarura, iki gikoresho kigira imbogamizi amasaha 24: nta guhindura uruhare cyangwa kwishyurwa, nta gukuraho ibindi bikoresho, nta kohereza amakuru.
texts.screens_hint: Hitamo ishusho. Kwiyandikisha, kwinjira no kugarura bikurikiza amategeko yemeranyijwe: infunguzo zo kwinjira mbere, SMS yonyine ntihagije na rimwe, igihe cyo gutegereza gishobora guhagarikwa.
texts.security_always: Imenyesha ry'umutekano rihora rigera, nta huza na rimwe.
texts.signin_hint: Konti imwe ku hantu hose ha LynkOmni.
texts.signin_new_device_note: Igikoresho cyangwa ahantu hashya? Tukubwira kuri buri nzira, nta huza mu butumwa.
texts.signin_passkey_hint: Telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa yawe yemeza ko ari wowe. Nta jambo ry'ibanga ryo kwibuka.
texts.signin_pin: Shyiramo PIN yawe kuri telefoni yanditswe
texts.standing_intro: Kwishyura bihoraho ni itegeko ryawe bwite: umupaka ushyiraho, ubitswe n'uwatanze serivisi wemewe, kandi umenyeshwa buri gihe bikoreshejwe.
texts.start_approved: Byemejwe. Ubucuruzi bwawe {lynkoid} buriteguye muri LynkOmni.
texts.start_intro: Andikisha ubucuruzi, bona nimero y'umusoro ufungure konti ya banki y'ubucuruzi binyuze ku irembo rya leta no muri banki zo mu gihugu cyawe. Ni ubuntu kuri wowe; amafaranga ya leta ajya kuri leta ako kanya.
texts.start_submitted: Byoherejwe. Ubuyobozi ni bwo bufata icyemezo; igisubizo cyabwo tukigaragaza hano.
texts.stepup_hint: Hakenewe igenzura rishya kuri ibi. Shyiramo kode twohereje.
texts.username_change_note: Izina ryawe rya kera rikomeza kukwerekana kandi ntirizigera rihabwa undi.
texts.wallet_empty: Ikofi yawe irimo ubusa. Amatike, impapuro z'agaciro, kode za eSIM n'amanota yo muri buri iduka bigaragara hano.
texts.ws_help: Ibitabo, fagitire, abo tuvugana na raporo bimwe kuri wowe, ikigo cyangwa umuryango.
texts.ws_note: Ibiciro n'amategeko bimwe kuri bose. Nta mashini ikenewe.
